notes.title: STEAM ACHIEVEMENT !
notes.content:
=> Implementation of achievement steam
For example:
- Purchase of colours
- End of map
- Boost your bird
- First visit to the toilet 
- Passage to the store
and so on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37284163/13d5e28f38c0ef521a808547e4b91ac6b810fc02.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.1.2 : addition and correction
notes.content:
[b]- Bug correction[/b]
=> fixed map bug in "city".

[b]- Sound change[/b]
=> "Forest Road" music update.

[b]- Adding animation for startup assistance[/b]
=> Added an animation to help launching a game and locating controller control parameters (only during first games).

[b]- Activating / Deactivating the trail[/b]
=> Add the possibility to disable the trail in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37284163/12d002d8aa67d43a389e2d93ed6a233c4340a645.png[/img]

Good games to all! ːsteamhappyː
